author: National Geographic
description:
How important is biodiversity to farming? Join National Geographic photographer Matthieu Paley on the Waitrose Farm at the Leckford Estate England to learn the importance of healthy soil in creating a biodiverse and self-sustaining ecosystem. Biodiversity benefits farms with crop protection, increased pollinators, nutrient cycling, and healthier soil. All of this works together to create better, responsibly grown products on people's plates.
